inputs.goal: source a data-warehouse vendor under a 120k budget, award by Q4

shards: SaaS-based data warehouse solutions under $120k annual license + implementation
Cloud-native platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) with flexible pricing
Hybrid cloud architectures supporting both on-premises and cloud deployments
Vendor evaluation criteria including scalability, security, integration capabilities
Proposed 30-day RFP timeline with Q4 award window

rfp.map.shard_result: SaaS-based data warehouse solutions under $120k annual license + implementation

Snowflake, BigQuery, and Redshift are the leading cloud-native data warehouse platforms with flexible pricing models. Snowflake offers tiered pricing based on compute and storage usage with automatic scaling. BigQuery provides pay-per-query and slot-based pricing with reservation options. Redshift features provisioned compute nodes with spot instance discounts. All three platforms support $120k annual budget constraints with various deployment configurations. Recommended to conduct detailed comparison testing focusing on query performance, integration capabilities, and total cost of ownership within the budget limit.

Hybrid cloud architectures support both on-premises and cloud deployments, enabling organizations to leverage existing infrastructure while scaling into cloud environments as needed, ideal for gradual migration strategies and mixed workloads

Scalability: Evaluate vendor's ability to handle data growth and processing demands; Security: Assess data encryption, access controls, compliance certifications (GDPR, SOC 2); Integration capabilities: Test connectivity with existing tools (CRM, ERP, BI platforms), API availability, ETL tool compatibility
Finalize RFP document with 30-day timeline, including vendor evaluation criteria and Q4 award commitment, while maintaining budget alignment under $120k
